records.name: Christ University Bangalore
records.description: Christ University, Bengaluru is a deemed university known for its liberal arts, commerce, science, and management programs, with a strong emphasis on holistic education and research.

records.name: Indian Statistical Institute Kolkata
records.description: Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) Kolkata is a premier autonomous institution established in 1931 by P.C. Mahalanobis, renowned globally for research and education in statistics, mathematics, and computer science. It offers B.Stat, M.Stat, M.Math, and PhD programs and is recognized as an Institute of National Importance. ISI Kolkata is consistently ranked among the top institutions for statistics and mathematics research in Asia.

records.name: Chennai Mathematical Institute
records.description: Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI) is a leading research and education center in mathematics and computer science, founded in 1989. It offers BSc, MSc, and PhD programs in Mathematics, Computer Science, and Data Science, attracting top mathematical talent from across India. CMI is known for its rigorous academic environment and strong research output in pure and applied mathematics.

records.name: IIT Bombay (Mathematics)
records.description: The Department of Mathematics at IIT Bombay is one of India's foremost centers for mathematical education and research, offering BTech, MSc, MTech, and PhD programs. The department is recognized for excellence in areas including algebra, analysis, combinatorics, and applied mathematics. It plays a key role in interdisciplinary research across engineering and science at one of India's premier technical institutes.

records.name: IIT Madras (Mathematics)
records.description: The Department of Mathematics at IIT Madras offers BS, MS, and PhD programs with a strong focus on both pure and applied mathematics. The department is known for its research in areas such as numerical analysis, mathematical biology, fluid mechanics, and algebra. It collaborates extensively with engineering departments, making it a hub for interdisciplinary mathematical research in India.

records.name: University of Hyderabad
records.description: University of Hyderabad (UoH) is a central university established in 1974, consistently ranked among India's top universities for research and postgraduate education. It offers strong programs across sciences, humanities, social sciences, and technology, with particular strength in chemistry, physics, mathematics, and life sciences. UoH is recognized as an Institution of Eminence by the Government of India.

records.name: Institute of Actuaries of India
records.description: The Institute of Actuaries of India (IAI) is the professional body regulating the actuarial profession in India, established under an Act of Parliament in 2006. It conducts examinations and awards Fellowship qualifications recognized globally, covering life insurance, general insurance, health, pensions, and finance. IAI plays a central role in developing actuarial talent and standards across India's rapidly growing insurance and financial sectors.

records.name: IGNOU (Actuarial Science)
records.description: Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) offers a Post Graduate Diploma in Actuarial Science (PGDAS) through distance learning, making actuarial education accessible across India. As the world's largest open university, IGNOU provides flexible learning options for working professionals seeking to enter the actuarial field. The program prepares students for professional actuarial examinations conducted by IAI.

records.name: Amity University (Actuarial Science)
records.description: Amity University offers a specialized BSc and MSc program in Actuarial Science at its Noida campus, designed to prepare students for professional actuarial examinations. The program covers statistics, mathematics, finance, and insurance principles in alignment with IAI and international actuarial syllabi. Amity's strong industry connections provide students with internship and placement opportunities in insurance and financial services.

records.name: Bishop Heber College
records.description: Bishop Heber College, Tiruchirappalli, is an autonomous Christian minority institution affiliated with Bharathidasan University, established in 1966. It is known for its strong undergraduate and postgraduate programs in sciences, commerce, arts, and humanities, and has been accredited with 'A+' grade by NAAC. The college is particularly recognized for its mathematics, physics, and computer science departments.
